en: A monochrome illustrated advertising postcard for the flower growers and florists firm Gerretsen & Valeton. It shows a bird's‑eye view of extensive greenhouses and nursery fields with a few houses and paths, decorative roses, and an inset of an ornate city building labeled as a flower shop. There is a royal coat of arms at the top left and multiple Dutch texts promoting the company's nursery in Hees and flower shop in Nijmegen, the Netherlands.
